Let’s call him…
I might regret it later, but it’s already paid for so whatever.
You: Uhm, Hello?
???: Hello. You have reached Dr. Blaubleim’s clinic. How can I help you?
It’s his secretary. I never really saw her.
I don’t know why, but even when being there in person she’s in another room, looking at people through cameras…
Kinda creepy.
You: Yeah, It’s me, Anon.
You: My mom told me that she registered me for a visit.
Blaubleim’s secretary: …
Blaubleim’s secretary: Please give me a moment.
